test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who was the first chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. S Radhakrishnan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Dr. S Radhakrishnan**

__
 
• **2nd President of India** from** 1962 to 1967 **
 
• **1st Vice President of India** from** 1952 to 1962**.
 
• **2nd Ambassador of India to Soviet Union** from **1949 to 1952**
 
• **4th Vice-Chancellor of Banaras Hindu University** from** 1939 to 1948**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Shri M Hidayatullah

 
• **11th Chief Justice of India** from **25 February 1968 to 16 December 1970.**
 
• **6th vice president of India **from **31 August 1979 to 30 August 1984**.
 
• **acting president of India** from **20 July 1969 to 24 August 1969** and from** 6 October 1982 to 31 October 1982 **and from **25 July 1983 to 25 July 1983.**** **

**Dr. Zakir Husain**

 
• **3rd president of India **from **13 May 1967 to 3 May 1969.**
 
• **Governor of Bihar** from **1957 to 1962.**
 
• **2nd vice president of India** from** 1962 to 1967.**

**Shri VV Giri**

 
• **4th president of India** from **24 August 1969 to 24 August 1974**
 
• **3rd vice president of India **from **13 May 1967 to 3 May 1969**. 
 
• **1st president** to be **elected as an independent candidate.**
